''See also: [[Ach'magut Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Ach'magut, also known as the [[Overseer]], is a [[Great Elder]] characterized by an insatiable [[hunger]] for information and data. Described as a custodian of thought and a guardian of knowledge, this entity seeks to understand and control all things by consuming the collective wisdom of humanity. Ach'magut possesses an immense capacity for calculation and foresight, often delivering prophecies or predictions that carry the weight of inescapable destiny. Some believe these communications are not merely predictions but evidence of a vast, long-term plan laid out centuries ago. Physically, the entity is associated with many eyes and tentacles, including organic metallic appendages. Ach'magut is linked to the [[Inquisitors]], who act under its command, and has historical ties to groups like the [[Am’haranai|Am'haranai]]. While there are rumors that the [[Great Elder]] is imprisoned beneath [[Silverreach]], its status regarding life or death remains a subject of speculation. Despite being described as dead at various points, its influence persists through calculated manipulations and prophecies that have shaped the lives of individuals such as [[Calder]] and [[Shera]].}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Ach'magut is a dead [[Great Elder]] and the [[Overseer]] known as the [[Lord]] of a [[Thousand Eyes]]. This entity, which exists as an ancient dream and a world unto itself, is composed of a mass of limbs, ears, tendrils, and eyes, including a single human-shaped eye with a hypnotic blue iris. Though rumored to be imprisoned beneath [[Silverreach]], this force maintains a [[library]] and feasts upon the collected knowledge of humanity. Ach'magut communicates through a language of [[Intent]], allowing the being to read potential paths of choice and provide factually correct predictions of the future. While its [[Inquisitors]] praise it for sending new followers, the entity remains an oppressive presence that can analyze emotions and physical compositions through its tentacles.}}

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|A [[Great Elder]] whose spawn are the spider-like [[Inquisitors]], Ach'magut began to stir in the town of [[Silverreach]] four years ago. As a parasite that leeches onto worlds, he seeks to deconstruct every speck of data and will even take things apart to understand how they work. Known as the [[Overseer]], he possesses an eternal appetite that can never be sated and views the world as a game board where people are merely game pieces. He communicates through direct injections of [[Intent]] and desires the future, intending to remain on this world for another ten thousand years.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|As an Elder possessing infinite knowledge, Ach'magut operates according to a specific plan and a prophecy that they may have even authored. The entity previously promised [[Calder]] that he would rule, providing him with an image of himself wearing the Emperor's [[gold crown]] and a title as the Emperor of the World. [[Calder]] has experienced the immense force of Ach'magut's projected will, and after sharing knowledge with [[Calder]] and [[Kelarac]], the entity allowed them to depart. While Ach'magut was responsible for planning the creation of the [[crack in the sky]], they were also dealt with by the Emperor several years prior.}}
